headline: Dead Lands and Fishermans Row Drive Frontline Turmoil
war_summary: Since the 0900 edition the map has shifted from a broad flare‑up to a tighter set of hot spots. Dead Lands remains the most volatile sector, logging three ownership changes in the last two hours and sustaining a combined casualty rate above 1,400 per hour for both factions. Fishermans Row, which previously recorded seven captures in two hours, shows no fresh flips in the latest window, though its 24‑hour tally still stands at twenty‑eight changes and loss rates above 170 and 240 per hour. Linn Mercy, yesterday’s busiest hex, has gone quiet with zero events in the past two hours despite accelerating casualty curves near 260 and 280 per hour. Lykos Isle continues to bleed heavily — over 20 casualties per hour each side — and added two captures in the last two hours. Stlican Shelf and Stonecradle each recorded a handful of flips over the day but none in the most recent period. Meanwhile, Weathered Expanse and Callahans Passage exhibit sharply rising attrition on both sides without territorial movement. Overall, base turnover is now concentrated in Dead Lands and Lykos Isle, while the broader front bleeds manpower in entrenched, static fights.
